Maria (partnerships): Heads-up — AWS marketplace is doing a usage-shard-key rotation next Wed 09:00 PT. Does our partner test harness need any changes?

Kevin (finance): Thanks for the heads-up. Are the rotated keys per-partner or per-region? We need to know for billing reconciliation. :thinking_face:

Maria (partnerships): Per-partner + rolling by region. They said keys will be replaced every 30 days and old keys will continue to be accepted for 48h after rotation.

Alice (eng): That 48h grace window is fine for normal ingestion, but our staging adapters cache the shard key in the connector config for 7 days. We should add a short TTL refresh in the harness.

Raj (eng-sre): Agreed. Suggest adding a background poll that hits the key endpoint and reloads keys atomically. Something like:

```
# pseudo
while true:\n  keys = GET https://partners.aws.marketplace/keys?partner_id=$ID\n  atomic_swap(local_keys, keys)\n  sleep 15m
```

Raj (eng-sre): Also watch for eventual consistency in the vendor metadata — if a region flip happens during rotation we might see mismatched shard_id -> region mapping. Add tolerant parsing and metric.

Eve (si-onboarding): For SI test harnesses we run long-lived load tests that assume a static shard header. If keys rotate mid-run we'll get 401s and alerts. Can we support retry-with-refresh in the harness?

Alice (eng): Yes — add logic: on 401, call the keys endpoint once and replay the single request. Don't retry more than twice to avoid tight loops.

Kevin (finance): From billing side, we need to ensure late-arrival events still map to the correct partner. If keys change, do they change the partner_id?

Maria (partnerships): No, partner_id is stable. Only shard_key value rotates. They promised metadata immutability for partner_id and entitlement mapping.

marketplace-bot: NOTE: AWS Marketplace rotation scheduled 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z. See https://status.aws.marketplace/rotations/3401234567

Raj (eng-sre): Action items: 1) Alice: add key-polling to harness + 401-refresh logic (low risk) 2) Eve: update SI long-run tests to surface 401 spike metric 3) Kevin: I'll add an alert to billing reconciliation if partner_id mismatch rate > 0.1% over 1h.

Alice (eng): I'll open a small PR with the poller (target: feature/keys-rot). Quick snippet for the refresh path: `if resp.status == 401: refresh_keys(); retry(request)`

Eve (si-onboarding): I'll update the load test manifest and run a smoke after PR merge.

Kevin (finance): Good plan. Please ping me when the smoke is done so I can validate ledgers.

Maria (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll loop in the AWS contact to coordinate the exact rotation windows per region and request a pre-rotation summary CSV (partner_id, old_key_id, new_key_id, region). :pray:

Raj (eng-sre): One more note — make sure the logs include shard_key_id (hashed) not full key, to avoid leaking secrets in logs.

Alice (eng): Agreed. We'll log `shard_key_id=sha256(key)[0:8]` and mask the rest.

Maria (partnerships): Perfect. I'll update the partner runbook and post the schedule here when I have it.

Kevin (finance): :thumbsup:
